scope: Approved-intent alignment, work plan and repository task management; no product source, bridge, UI or historical research dataset changes.
limitations: No runtime feature implementation or comparative performance result is claimed.
Real-provider release checks and experiments still require their explicitly recorded quota authorization.

findings_addressed: Removed unnecessary dependencies among native settings, permissions, budgets, narration, memory and UI work.
Reduced upfront design to the minimal transition/authority contract using existing components.
Moved acceptance-fixture preparation earlier and made integrated release testing depend explicitly on all required features.
Consolidated interface/release planning and removed duplicated policy prose.
Made tasks.json the single source for both generated Markdown views with seven requested markers, UTC timestamps and derived readiness.
Separated explicit owner questions from dependency blocking and excluded research/planning completion from delivery counts.
